# mobius 0.17.2

Adds A2Agent as an API-key provider using the shared Responses transport. Its catalog advertises text and tool use; image input and image generation are disabled. Configure model IDs through the existing provider catalog and model selection.

Includes the 0.17 Rust API changes. See the [0.17.1 release notes](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/releases/tag/mobius-v0.17.1) when upgrading from 0.16.
